verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents an official CLI that gives AI agents and scripts full access to workspaces. A single `cio api` command covers the Journeys UI API and the CDP Data Pipelines API. Every command returns structured JSON, endpoints are self-describing via `cio schema`, and an official skill teaches AI assistants to drive the CLI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working as claimed.
